svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 40 mm lengths of 25 x 6 mm steel flat bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grind one 40 x 25 face flat and clean to bright metal; this is where

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the dummy gauge goes. Round the edges lightly.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bond a gauge of the same type and batch as the active gauge to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle of the bright face, the same way round as the active gauge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Solder its leads, coat it with the same coating as the active gauge,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: set it on the flange top, its centre 35 out from the web face,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on a bed of neutral-cure silicone, so it takes the steel's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: temperature but none of its strain. Never glue it rigidly.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the coupon can be lifted by hand once the silicone has cured.
